elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 still prohibits the Company from participating in similar Internet projects involving Deerskin Products and grants HDI an exclusive brand-use right.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The restriction is limited to “Deerskin Products,” a supplied defined term.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The Exclusivity Period is expressly limited to twelve months commencing on the Effective Date.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: Termination applies only to a material failure of HDI’s obligations that remains uncured for 30 days after notice; it does not expressly or unconditionally cover failure to meet service levels.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly covers only failure to make the Site operational within the Section 1.6 period; other delivery-date failures are not expressly covered and would at most be subject to materiality, notice, and a 30-day cure period.
